lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 distinct white vertical lines of varying intensity; spacing is irregular with the widest intervals occurring in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most and posterior-most lines are abbreviated, terminating before the ventral boundary of the torso; the markings on the rump appear as a vertical series of dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three high-contrast white spots are visible in a localized cluster on the lower haunch above the posterior hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two lower-most spots on the haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric axis across the upper thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate horns with an initial upward-lateral trajectory of approximately 70 degrees from the cranial base, curving medially at the apical third.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.2 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 0.15 of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the torso and hindquarters; prominent white facial markings include a single inter-orbital chevron and dual maxillary spots.
